youtube_title: Gas Smell at Home: Switch On the Light or Open the Windows? Brave vs Normal #12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #12. You come home and the kitchen smells strongly of gas. Brave wants to switch the light on to find the leak. Normal won't touch any switch and opens the windows. Who's right?
Answer: Normal. LPG safety advice: during a leak don't switch anything electrical ON or OFF and don't use fans - a spark can ignite the gas. Put out all flames, turn the regulator off, open all doors and windows, get out, and call the LPG emergency helpline 1906 (24x7, IndianOil / public-sector LPG customers).
Source: IndianOil 1906 LPG Emergency Helpline; LPG company safety advice.
